items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 14:1
items.html: There are three Sefirot that do not receive correction during the months of pregnancy: Gevura, which is the discernment of the left line of HGT, does not receive correction, since there is not yet the level of HGT there, only the level of NHY. And there is nothing in this level but the discernment of Tifferet and Yesod, included one within the other, so that Gevura is not decided by them; and also Netzah and Hod are not fully clarified for this reason, since they are included within HGT and have no revelation in their own place. See further in Answer 32. (Items 8, 9).
